findings.outcome: Task40 technical execution valid; J1 264/264 imposed and autonomous trajectory checks pass, but 22/168 autonomous intervention case-seed checks fail. No GO to Task41.
findings.localization: All 22 failures concern calcium channels: 18 Ca_LVAst, 4 Ca_HVA. I3 and J1 fail identical cases. All are early_high protocols: 10 distinct intervention/source cases, not 22 independent protocols.
findings.numerical_floor: All 672 saved intervention verdicts reproduced. Recalculation maximum numeric discrepancy: 5.59e-10. Casting before subtraction changes no verdict. Formula FP32 versus FP64 passes 56/56 differential controls; candidates still fail 22/168 against FP64. Numerical roundoff alone is not supported.
findings.causal_channel_control: Frozen CPU replay matches 168/168 GPU differential flags. Learned calcium-only has 22 failures; learned all-except-calcium has 0. Restoring only Ca_LVAst leaves 4, only Ca_HVA leaves 18. Canonical substitutions are diagnostic oracles, not eligible candidates.
findings.kinetic_control: At fixed reference V/Ca and common initial state, learned Ca coefficients fail 22; oracle u still 22; oracle z gives 0; oracle m-z alone leaves 3. In this diagnostic, correcting relaxation coefficients suffices to remove failures; correcting equilibrium alone does not. This is a sufficiency result, not proof of a unique cause or learnability.
findings.readout_control: Reference V in readout leaves 22; reference m leaves 2; reference h leaves 17; reference m+h leaves 0. Dominant activation kinetics with a secondary inactivation contribution, not evidence that h can be ignored.
findings.why_J1_did_not_fix: Task39j learned corrections target only gates 8,9,12,13 (Nap_Et2,K_Pst). Calcium gates 0..3 remain I3. Their residual failure is not a regression introduced by 39j. Its atomic frozen-function method is a promising hypothesis to transfer, not proof of Ca repair.
findings.scope: The 32 historical native paths and 56 formula interventions are opened diagnostics, not fresh NEURON confirmation. Imposed mode mixes native base V/Ca with formula intervention V/Ca; consistent formula-path coefficient controls also reproduce 22 failures. Original NO-GO preserved.
findings.stress: Both known stress failures remain: Ca_LVAst offset (seed17, same_v_history case1) and Ca_HVA NRMSE (seed29, activation_boundary case0). Shared channels motivate testing a common repair but do not prove an identical cause.
findings.decision: Propose Task40b calcium kinetic precision diagnosis, not Task41. No training launched and no current threshold relaxed.

hypotheses.statement: Small learned calcium relaxation errors, especially m, cause the differential failures.
Pointwise coefficient accuracy does not sufficiently constrain local response slopes.
Independent FIT coverage or optimization budget is insufficient in sensitive calcium regimes.
Residual correction resolution limits achievable kinetic accuracy.
Joint equilibrium and relaxation corrections help learnability despite oracle-z sufficiency.
hypotheses.test: Samecapacity u+z correction versus z-only,protectparentfunction andreportparametercount.

hypotheses.statement: Correctingactivation alone suffices for every failure.
The same kinetic repair resolves the two long-path stress failures.
